name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_myasthenia_gravis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of myasthenia gravis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of myasthenia gravis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical diagnosis of myasthenia gravis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of myasthenia gravis.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_pyridostigmine_now@@unequivocal_clinical_response
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently exposed to pyridostigmine and has an unequivocal clinical response.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently exposed to pyridostigmine and has an unequivocal clinical response.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently exposed to pyridostigmine but does not have an unequivocal clinical response.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has an unequivocal clinical response to pyridostigmine.

name: patient_has_undergone_procedure_to_identify_antibody_now_outcome_is_positive
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone antibody testing now and the outcome is positive.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone antibody testing now and the outcome is positive.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone antibody testing now and the outcome is not positive.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone antibody testing now and the outcome is positive.

name: patient_repetitive_nerve_stimulation_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric percentage representing the patient's current decrement in repetitive nerve stimulations study.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such percentage measurement recorded now is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured percentage value if a numeric measurement of decrement in repetitive nerve stimulations study recorded now is available.

name: patient_has_decrement_gt_10_percent_in_repetitive_nerve_stimulation_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current decrement in repetitive nerve stimulations study is greater than 10%.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current decrement in repetitive nerve stimulations study is greater than 10%.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current decrement in repetitive nerve stimulations study is 10% or less.
when_unknown: Set to null if the decrement value is not available or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_supporting_evidence_for_mg_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has at least one supporting evidence for myasthenia gravis now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has at least one of the following supporting evidence for myasthenia gravis now: unequivocal clinical response to pyridostigmine, positive antibody testing, or decrement > 10% in repetitive nerve stimulations study.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has none of the supporting evidence for myasthenia gravis now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has any supporting evidence for myasthenia gravis now.
